name: garmin-coach
description: Pulls Garmin data and provides daily readiness, training load, fitness trend, and recent activity coaching

tools.name: calibrate
tools.description: Compute personal HRV and resting HR baselines from the last 30 days of Garmin data. Runs automatically on first use and silently every 7 days. Call manually after a significant fitness change.

tools.name: get_morning_metrics
tools.description: Fetch overnight Garmin metrics (HRV, resting HR, sleep, body battery, stress) and return a daily readiness decision: GREEN / AMBER / RED

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Fetch training status and compute ACWR (acute:chronic workload ratio) from the last 28 days of activities to assess overreach and injury risk

tools.name: get_fitness_trend
tools.description: Fetch VO2 Max values sampled weekly over the past 6 weeks to assess whether fitness is trending up, stable, or declining

tools.name: get_recent_activities
tools.description: Fetch the last 7 days of activities with distance, pace, average HR, and aerobic/anaerobic training effect scores

tools.name: analyze_run
tools.description: Fetch detailed running dynamics and form analysis for a specific activity. Returns cadence, stride length, ground contact time, ground contact balance, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio, running power, per-km splits, and HR zone breakdown with actionable form recommendations. If no activity_id is provided, analyses the most recent running activity.

tools.name: create_running_workout
tools.description: Create a structured running workout on Garmin Connect. Supports warmup, easy, interval (time or distance), recovery, cooldown, and repeat blocks. Returns the new workout_id which can be used with schedule_workout.

tools.name: create_strength_workout
tools.description: Create a strength/gym workout on Garmin Connect. Each exercise becomes a set of timed work+rest steps on the watch. Returns the new workout_id which can be used with schedule_workout.

tools.name: schedule_workout
tools.description: Schedule an existing Garmin workout to a specific calendar date. Use after create_running_workout or create_strength_workout to assign it to a day.

tools.name: get_weekly_review
tools.description: Review this week's training vs last week. Compares distance, time, sessions, best session, and ACWR. Ends with a coming-week recommendation based on load.

tools.name: get_monthly_review
tools.description: Review this calendar month's training vs last month. Covers volume, consistency, longest run, VO2 Max movement, and a focus area for next month.

tools.name: get_run_window
tools.description: Check today's weather and recommend the best time window to run. Auto-detects current location via IP, or accepts an optional location name (e.g. 'Mallusk', 'Belfast'). Weekdays: morning and lunch slots. Weekends: all daylight windows. Scored on precipitation, temperature, wind, and UV.

tools.name: setup_training_plan
tools.description: Set up or update the overarching half-marathon training plan. Call with no arguments to fetch Garmin race predictions and get a questionnaire. Call with race_date and training_days_per_week (minimum) to create the plan. Once set, all daily coaching tools automatically include plan context.

tools.name: get_plan_status
tools.description: Show full training plan status: race details, current week and phase, predicted vs target time, weekly structure, and phase breakdown. Returns setup instructions if no plan exists.

tools.name: clear_training_plan
tools.description: Delete the current training plan. Requires confirmation=true. Use when starting a new training cycle.
